description_en: Queries the status of the Alibaba Cloud CDN service. The returned information includes the current metering method, the service activation time, the next metering method that will take effect, and the current service status
description_zh: 调用DescribeCdnService查询CDN服务状态。包括：当前计费类型、服务开通时间、下次生效的计费类型、当前业务状态等
name: DescribeCdnService

ChangingAffectTime.description_en: The time when the next metering method takes effect. The time is in GMT
ChangingAffectTime.description_zh: 下次计费类型生效时间，GMT时间

ChangingChargeType.description_en:
The next metering method that will take effect.

PayByTraffic: by traffic.

PayByBandwidth: by peak bandwidth
ChangingChargeType.description_zh:
下次生效的计费类型。

PayByTraffic：流量。

PayByBandwidth：带宽峰值

ChangingDynamicBillingType.description_en: The next metering method for dynamic acceleration that will take effect
ChangingDynamicBillingType.description_zh: 下次生效的动态加速计费方式

DynamicBillingType.description_en: The metering method for dynamic acceleration

InternetChargeType.description_en:
The current metering method.

PayByTraffic: by traffic.

PayByBandwidth: by peak bandwidth

当前计费类型。

PayByTraffic：流量。

PayByBandwidth：带宽峰值

OpeningTime.description_en: The time when the service was activated. The time is in the ISO 8601 format
OpeningTime.description_zh: 开通服务时间，ISO 8601时间格式

LockReason.description_en: The lock status of the service
The reason why the service is locked. The value \`financial\` indicates an overdue payment
